# Prava Labs — full site text for language models

> Prava Labs, LLC is an independent software studio in California building local-first, private-by-design apps and on-device AI tools. This file carries the substance of every page on pravalabs.app: what each product does, what it costs, what it is not, and the answers on each support page. Contact: support@pravalabs.app.

## TradeSocial — live on the App Store
URL: https://pravalabs.app/tradesocial/

TradeSocial teaches investing by doing it, with nothing at risk. Start with $5,000 in virtual money and trade stocks, ETFs and crypto at real market prices, on your own for free. Form a group of up to eight friends, family or coworkers: everyone gets their own budget, the group grows it with milestone bonuses up to $15,000 per member, and you compare portfolios, talk trades in chat and climb the leaderboard together. 100% paper trading. iPhone and iPad.

Pricing: Solo 0 USD; Premium monthly 7.99 USD; Premium annual 79.99 USD.

What it does:
- $5,000 virtual portfolio at real market prices
- Stocks, ETFs and crypto
- Position detail with sparklines, daily change, total return and fundamentals
- Activity feed and trade history
- Reset the solo portfolio to start over
- Groups of up to eight with independent budgets
- Group portfolio, chat with trade cards, leaderboard and analytics
- Milestone bonuses of $2,500, $2,500 and $5,000 as a group grows
- Sign in with Apple, Google or email
- iPhone and iPad

Support questions:
- Q: Is TradeSocial real trading? A: No. TradeSocial is a paper-trading simulation for educational purposes only. You start with $5,000 in virtual funds and trade using real market data — but no real money is involved and no actual trades are placed on any exchange.
- Q: How do groups work? A: Groups require a Premium subscription ($7.99/month or $79.99/year). You can create or join up to 6 trading groups with friends, family, or coworkers. Each group supports up to 8 members. Each member gets their own $5,000 virtual budget. As more people join, the group unlocks milestone bonuses — everyone earns extra virtual funds together.
- Q: What are milestone bonuses? A: When your group reaches certain member counts, every member gets a budget boost: 4 members: +$2,500 bonus (total $7,500 per member) 6 members: +$2,500 more (total $10,000 per member) 8 members (full group): +$5,000 more (total $15,000 per member)
- Q: How do I join a group? A: Tap the Groups tab and choose "Join Group." Enter the invite code shared by the group creator. You'll be added instantly and receive your own virtual budget.
- Q: Can I have a solo portfolio and be in a group? A: Yes. Your solo portfolio is completely separate from any group portfolios. Solo trades are stored locally on your device, while group trades sync with all group members via the cloud.
- Q: What market data does the app use? A: TradeSocial uses real-time market data for stocks, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies to provide an authentic learning experience. Simulated trades execute at the current market price.
- Q: How do I delete my account? A: Go to Settings → Delete Account. This permanently removes your account, all portfolio data, and group memberships. This action cannot be undone.
- Q: Is my data private? A: Yes. We collect only what's needed to run the app (email, display name, and simulated trading data). We do not sell your data. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
- Q: The app isn't loading or is crashing — what should I do? A: Make sure you're running the latest version from the App Store Try force-quitting and reopening the app Check your internet connection (group features require connectivity) If the issue persists, email us at support@pravalabs.app with your device model and iOS version

Privacy: TradeSocial Privacy Policy. Learn how we protect your data in our educational trading simulation app.
Terms: TradeSocial Terms of Service. Read the terms governing use of our educational trading simulation app.

## Prava Toolport — live on the Mac App Store
URL: https://pravalabs.app/toolport/

Prava Toolport sits between any AI agent and all your MCP servers, handing the agent only the few right tools per task — in any language. Plus built-in modules: savings receipts, policy gates, output condensing, web retrieval, semantic cache, and durable memory.

Pricing: Solo Monthly 9.99 USD; Solo Annual 89.99 USD.

Support questions:
- Q: What exactly does Toolport do? A: Toolport sits between your AI agent and all your MCP servers. Instead of every server loading its full tool list into the agent's context, the agent gets three small meta-tools — search_tools, get_tool_schema, and invoke_tool — and discovers the right tools on demand. Same power, a fraction of the context.
- Q: Which agents work with Toolport? A: Any MCP-speaking client: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or your own agent. You register Toolport as a single MCP server in your agent's configuration, and it fronts every server you've added.
- Q: How do I add Toolport to Claude Code? A: Add Toolport as an MCP server in your Claude Code configuration (one entry). Toolport announces the search → schema → invoke workflow to the agent automatically when it connects — no system-prompt changes needed.
- Q: Do my existing MCP servers need changes? A: No. Toolport speaks standard MCP to your servers. Point it at the same server definitions you use today; it connects, asks each server for its tools, and indexes them. When a server's tools change, Toolport re-checks it automatically.
- Q: Does search work in languages other than English? A: Yes. Toolport uses cross-lingual embeddings, so a query in one language finds tools described in another — for example, a Japanese query can find an English-described tool.
- Q: Does Toolport require an internet connection? A: Semantic search and the index are fully local. You need network access only to reach remote MCP servers you've configured; local (stdio) servers and search itself work offline.
- Q: How does sign-in to hosted servers work? A: For remote servers that require OAuth (for example, Microsoft or GitHub hosted services), Toolport opens the provider's sign-in in your browser and stores the tokens locally on your machine. Your credentials never pass through Prava Labs.
- Q: Which platforms and installs are there? A: Same engine everywhere. On Mac (macOS 14+, Apple Silicon), the Mac App Store build sells the Solo tier billed by Apple — it is sandboxed, so it fronts remote (HTTP/OAuth) servers only; the direct download (notarized, unlocked with a license key) adds local (stdio) servers and carries Solo today, with Team and Enterprise coming soon. On Windows (10 & 11, native x64 & ARM64 — coming soon), the app is a free direct download that runs both local and remote servers at every tier, unlocked with the same license key. So local servers are available on every install except the sandboxed Mac App Store build.
- Q: I subscribed on the Mac App Store — can I switch to the direct download? A: Yes, without paying twice: Cancel the subscription in System Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions — Apple keeps it active until your renewal date, and we can't cancel it for you. Download the DMG edition whenever you like: it starts its own fresh 3-day trial, so you can set it up and confirm your local (stdio) servers work while your App Store subscription is still running. The two editions keep separate settings — you'll re-add your servers and OAuth sign-ins in the DMG edition. Email support with your Apple renewal date and we'll issue your Solo license key timed to start the day Apple's billing stops — no overlap, no gap in coverage. Your tier unlocks components. Solo is the individual plan — semantic search, all platform modules, the first-party connectors, and your own MCP servers (local and remote, except on the sandboxed Mac App Store build). Team adds a shared team registry with governance and audit receipts, security pre-screening of tools, and token/cost metering. Enterprise adds air-gapped / on-prem deployment (offline license, no phone-home), SSO (OIDC), and audit export to your SIEM. See the plans overview.
- Q: How does per-seat licensing work? A: Team and Enterprise are licensed per seat, where a seat is one user or agent — not a server and not a per-machine install. You run the registry on as many engine instances as you need for load or redundancy; servers are your infrastructure choice, not a licensing unit. For example, 20 users served by two load-balanced servers is 20 seats, not "two server licenses." Solo is a single seat for one person. (Prava Labs never sells per-server licenses — that would penalize running a redundant setup.)
- Q: The agent isn't finding my server's tools — what should I check? A: Make sure Toolport is running (check your menu bar on Mac, or the system tray on Windows) Open the Configure window and confirm the server shows as connected Use Re-index to rebuild the search index after changing servers Confirm your agent's config points at Toolport and was restarted after the change
- Q: The app is misbehaving — what should I do? A: Make sure you're running the latest version Quit and relaunch Toolport from the menu bar Check the built-in diagnostics view for connection errors If issues persist, email support@pravalabs.app with your platform and OS version (macOS or Windows), and a description of the problem

Privacy: Prava Toolport Privacy Policy. Your tool index stays on your device, and Toolport talks only to the MCP servers you configure.
Terms: Prava Toolport Terms of Service: the licence for the Mac app and the direct download, tiers and per-seat licensing, purchases through the Mac App Store, what Toolport does with the MCP servers you configure, warranties and liability.
Download: Get Prava Toolport for Mac today — Windows coming soon. Free 3-day trial, then Solo at $9.99/mo or $89.99/yr. Mac App Store or direct download with license-key activation.

## BoatNavi — in TestFlight
URL: https://pravalabs.app/boatnavi/

Navi and Boat, one chart. Navi: charted depth plus the tide, minus your draft and margin, coloured on the chart for the next 48 hours across San Francisco Bay and the Sacramento–San Joaquin Delta, South Bay to West Sacramento — offline. Boat: your instruments over Signal K, NMEA 0183 or Raymarine SeaTalk1, batteries, tanks, the autopilot, and an anchor watch that wakes you.

Support questions:
- Q: What is the number under the keel? A: Charted depth + water level − your draft − your safety margin, for the point under the crosshair or under your boat, at the time on the scrubber. The chart's colours are the same number everywhere: green is clear, amber is marginal, red is aground. The margin is taken out of every number you see; the default is 2 ft and the app will not encourage less.
- Q: Is BoatNavi a navigation system? A: No. It is a planning aid. It tells you which windows are worth attempting from the chart and the tide; your eyes and your depth sounder tell you what is actually under the keel. Public bathymetry outside dredged channels can be years old, and Delta shoals move. The survey year is on every callout and old surveys are hatched on the chart.
- Q: Which waters are covered? A: San Francisco Bay and the Delta, in seven regions: South Bay, Central Bay & Golden Gate, San Pablo Bay & Napa River, Carquinez Strait & Suisun Bay, West Delta, North Delta, and the Sacramento River to West Sacramento. Download the regions you sail from Menu › Chart packs over Wi-Fi before you go; the chart continues from one region into the next as you sail.
- Q: Does it work with no signal? A: Everything that decides whether you go aground works offline: the charted depth is in the downloaded region, the tide is computed on the device, and your position is GPS. The only part that needs a network is the live tide correction from NOAA's gauges; without it the chart uses the prediction and says so with a chip.
- Q: How do I connect my boat's instruments? A: Menu › Boat connections. Your phone's GPS is the default. If your boat runs a Signal K server (a Raspberry Pi, OpenPlotter or a Victron GX) or an NMEA 0183 Wi-Fi gateway, join the boat's Wi-Fi and the server is offered by name; or type its address. Typing a host or IP uses http on the port shown; a full URL (https://…) is used as written. The Boat screen then shows the battery, charger, engine, tanks, cabin and autopilot, each with how fresh the reading is.
- Q: How does the anchor watch work? A: Tap the anchor chip, set the rode, check the depth, and tap Drop the anchor as it goes down. The circle is the rode's reach along the bottom plus your boat's length plus GPS scatter; set your length and bow height under Menu › Vessel. Dragging outside the circle, losing the fix, or a fix too poor to trust takes the screen and sounds until you acknowledge it — through the silent switch and with the screen off. Keep the phone plugged in for the night. Acknowledging quiets the alarm for five minutes; only Raise the anchor stops the watch.
- Q: The Alarm Did Not Sound A: Check the watch's own health list on the anchor screen: volume off, notifications refused, and a low battery are each listed there with a remedy. Allow notifications for BoatNavi in Settings, so an alarm reaches a locked phone. Keep the app running; force-quitting it ends the watch.
- Q: The Chart Is Blank or Says "No Chart Pack" A: Open Menu › Chart packs and download the region for where you are; the card at the top names it. A region that failed its survey check will not open, and says so.
- Q: The app is misbehaving — what should I do? A: Make sure you're running the latest version (Menu › Settings shows the build) Quit and relaunch BoatNavi If issues persist, email support@pravalabs.app with your device, iOS version, the build shown in Settings, and a description of the problem

Privacy: BoatNavi Privacy Policy. Your position, your tracks and your boat's data stay on your device. No account, no analytics, no tracking.

## Pravida — in TestFlight
URL: https://pravalabs.app/pravida/

Pravida is a private, invite-only, end-to-end encrypted messenger for the people you actually know. Create a chat, share a link or QR code, and talk — every message encrypted on your device with keys that never leave it, relayed through iCloud or sent directly between nearby devices over Wi‑Fi when there is no internet. No account, no phone number, no server of ours. Smart replies, summaries and translation run on the device. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.

What it does:
- Invite-only chats by link or QR code, with expiring invites
- End-to-end encryption with AES-256-GCM and keys generated on the device
- Direct device-to-device messaging over Wi‑Fi with no internet
- iCloud relay when members are apart
- Replies, reactions, forwarding, typing indicators, read receipts, link previews, search
- Photos, videos, files, voice messages and view-once photos
- Disappearing messages from 5 seconds to a week
- Safety numbers, verification and identity-key change alerts
- App Lock with Face ID or Touch ID
- Screenshot alerts
- On-device smart replies, summaries and translation with Apple Intelligence
- Native apps for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch

Support questions:
- Q: Do I need an account or a phone number? A: No. Pravida generates a cryptographic identity on your device the first time it runs. That is the account: there is nothing to register, no phone number and no email. Set a display name under Settings › Profile so members know who you are.
- Q: How do I start a chat with someone? A: Tap + and create a chat. Open its info screen (ⓘ) and choose Create Invite Link: share the link, or show the QR code to someone standing next to you. They tap the link, scan the code, or paste the link into Join. The invite expires on the schedule you pick, from one hour to 30 days. Treat the link like a key. Anyone who holds it can join the chat until it expires, so hand it over in person or through a channel you trust, and pick a short expiry for anything you post.
- Q: Does Pravida work without internet? A: With members nearby, yes. Devices on the same Wi‑Fi network, or within peer‑to‑peer Wi‑Fi range, exchange messages directly. The first time, iPhone and iPad ask for Local Network permission; allow it, or nearby messaging cannot see other devices. Members elsewhere are reached through iCloud, which needs the internet and an iCloud account signed in on the device. Pravida does not use Bluetooth, and a message does not hop through one device to reach another.
- Q: Is my chat end-to-end encrypted? A: Yes. Every message, photo, file and voice note is encrypted on your device with AES‑256‑GCM before it goes anywhere. Keys are generated on the device and kept in its Keychain; Prava Labs runs no servers and holds no keys. The iCloud relay stores ciphertext plus the ids and timestamps it needs to deliver it, and never sees content. Read what leaves your device, and in what form.
- Q: What is a safety number, and how do I verify someone? A: Open a member from the chat's info screen. Their safety number is a fingerprint of your identity key and theirs, shown as numbers and as a QR code. Compare it in person, or over a call you trust, and tap Mark as Verified. If their identity key ever changes, Pravida alerts everyone in the chat and clears the badge until you have checked again. A changed key usually means a new device or a reinstall; ask them before you trust it.
- Q: A message says pending, or cannot be decrypted yet A: Your device has not yet received that member's announcement, which carries what it needs to derive the key for their messages. It usually arrives within seconds once both devices are online or nearby, and the message decrypts on its own when it does. If it never arrives, both of you should open the chat while online, or while on the same Wi‑Fi.
- Q: Do the smart replies and summaries send my messages anywhere? A: No. Smart replies, the unread summary and translation run on Apple's on-device model, on iPhones, iPads and Macs with Apple Intelligence. Where the model is not available, including on Apple Watch, the features are absent rather than sent elsewhere. Settings › Intelligence turns them off with one switch.
- Q: How do disappearing messages work? A: Set a timer for a chat, from 5 seconds to a week. Messages you send after that are deleted on every member's device when the timer runs out. Delete for Everyone removes a message from every device now; Delete for Me removes it from yours only.
- Q: How do I lock the app? A: Settings › Security › App Lock on iPhone and iPad asks for Face ID, Touch ID or Optic ID before the app opens, and puts a cover over your chats in the app switcher. The Mac relies on its own login and lock screen.
- Q: Why does my Apple Watch say to open Pravida on my iPhone? A: The Watch shares your iPhone's identity, so members see one of you rather than two. Open Pravida on the iPhone once, with the Watch paired and both devices signed into the same iCloud account; the Watch picks up the identity within seconds. The Watch talks to iCloud only, so messages sent nearby over Wi‑Fi reach it once they have been relayed.
- Q: How do I back up a chat? A: From the chat's info screen, Backup & Restore writes a file encrypted with the chat's own key: the chat's settings and member roster. Restore from File reads it on another device. Export Chat History writes an encrypted file of message metadata (ids, senders, times, status) with no message text. Your messages themselves live on your devices; there is no cloud copy to download.
- Q: How do I delete everything? A: Delete All Data, at the bottom of Settings, removes every chat, key and setting from that device. Members' devices keep the messages you already sent them, as with any messenger. Deleting the app does the same.
- Q: The app is misbehaving — what should I do? A: Make sure you're running the latest version (Settings shows the build) Check that both devices are signed into iCloud, and on the same Wi‑Fi if you expect nearby messaging Quit and relaunch Pravida on both devices If issues persist, email support@pravalabs.app with your device, OS version, the build shown in Settings, and a description of the problem

Privacy: Pravida Privacy Policy. Your messages are end-to-end encrypted on your device and relayed through your own iCloud. No account, no phone number, no analytics, no tracking, no server of ours.
Terms: Pravida Terms of Service. The terms governing use of the Pravida encrypted messenger for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
